messages:
maria_cs: Hey team — quick sync for Aurora's private deployment. They've scheduled network handover tomorrow 09:00 PT. Goal: complete VPC peering, KMS key provisioning, and audit-log forwarding before the enablement session next week. Link to checklist: https://redwood.internal/onboard/aurora

jason_se: Thanks. Is Aurora going to bring their own KMS or will we provision a customer-managed CMK in their account?

maria_cs: They want customer-managed in their AWS account. Asked for rotation policy and HSM-backed key.

alex_plat: For VPC peering, confirm they have route table entries for the /27 we allocate. Also need security group rule: allow TCP 443 from our NAT subnets.

sara_sec: Audit logs: they want CloudTrail -> S3 w/ bucket ACLs locked down + CloudWatch Logs subscription to our central account. Also need to confirm S3 public access block and SSE-KMS on the bucket.

kevin_eng: Runbook note: when we create the CMK, set KeyUsage=ENCRYPT_DECRYPT and KeyPolicy to include the service principal for redwood-private. I'll attach the terraform snippet in the next message.

deploy-bot: preflight-checker: run started for aurora-private. Result: 1 failure detected. Details: KMS policy missing redwood principal.

maria_cs: Ugh, ok. @jason_se can you handle the CMK policy change? It's blocking the preflight.

jason_se: On it. I'll push a policy update and request Aurora to confirm key alias. Pasting a quick policy example:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    { "Effect": "Allow", "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-service" }, "Action": "kms:*", "Resource": "*" }
  ]
}
```

alex_plat: Also, note their subnets are in different AZs than our NAT gateway. Need to set up cross-AZ routing — might add 2-3 hours to the window if we reconfigure.

maria_cs: Good call. @kevin_eng can we prepare a fallback: allow temporary routed traffic via our transit GW and remove after cutover?

kevin_eng: Yep. I'll draft a playbook: create static routes in transit, tag resources, and a rollback plan. Expect ~45m ops time.

sara_sec: One more compliance item — Aurora asked for 90-day access review for admin IAM principals. We'll need to capture a list of privileged roles and owners before go‑live. Can CS own that collection?

maria_cs: I can collect owners; will ask Aurora PM for role owners today.

deploy-bot: preflight-checker: re-run started for aurora-private. Result: pass (except audit delivery delay warnings).

jason_se: Re: audit delivery warnings — their CloudTrail is using multi-region disabled. We recommended multi-region for resiliency. I've flagged it as a recommended change, not a block.

maria_cs: Update for stakeholders: Blocker cleared (KMS policy updated). Pending items: subnet route adjustments, audit delivery tuning, and IAM owners list.

kevin_eng: I've scheduled a maintenance window with infra for tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PT. I'll be on call.

maria_cs: Thanks. I'll run an enablement session draft tomorrow 14:00 PT for Aurora engineers to walk through the KMS and audit setup. Invite sent.

sara_sec: Can we capture feedback after the enablement? Quick Google Form or a 15m follow-up? I'd prefer form + optional follow-up call.

maria_cs: Agreed. I'll send a short survey (3 questions) and schedule a 15m check-in 48h after go‑live.

jason_se: FYI — renewal health: Aurora is on an annual contract renewing in 10 months. They mentioned cost sensitivity around Dedicated pricing; expect questions if we surface higher-than-projected token costs during private run. Let's log that as a risk.

maria_cs: Noted. Adding 'renewal risk: cost variance' to the account health doc and will loop PM to discuss cost optimization (batching, quantization).

kevin_eng: For action items: (1) jason — confirm CMK alias and policy (done), (2) alex — update route tables and transit GW fallback (in progress), (3) sara — collect IAM owners (waiting), (4) maria — enablement + survey (pending).

maria_cs: Thanks all. Quick parity check: @alex_plat please confirm when routes are live so I can flip the final preflight. :thumbsup:

alex_plat: Routes live at 09:38 PT. Verified connectivity to private endpoints and port 443. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: preflight-checker: final run complete. All gates passed.

maria_cs: Great — moving to go‑live tomorrow. Postmortem: capture any onboarding friction in the shared doc. Thanks team! :rocket:
